text_block_list.text:
While passing by the old science prep 
room—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Let's go treasure hunting!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! You've gotta help clean up Cafe 
and the others' room!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you curious what kinds of things 
are lying around? It's just like a 
treasure hunt!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Care to join us? The more hands on deck, 
the more it'll help the two of them!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh... What a terrible mess... Though that 
just means there's that much more treasure 
buried here!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That purple liquid... is medicine, right? 
What kind of effect does it have?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? It's an unexpected byproduct, 
you see. An irregularity occurred in an 
already established recipe.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the occasional trouble is just the 
spice of a voyage! It wouldn't be any fun 
otherwise!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's that... A rock is floating on 
the water!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: A meteorite?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that possibility isn't zero either. 
It's still being analyzed, so I can't say 
for certain, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I'm thinking of ways to 
leverage that unique trait in races. Heh 
heh.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Medicine that lets you run like you're 
floating... Is that what you mean? I 
wonder what that feels like!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I know! Since you're at it, make it so I 
can run on the ocean, not just on the 
turf!!

Though my attention was wandering, I 
finished tidying up the lab and moved over 
to Manhattan Cafe's space.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hey. What kind of treasure is packed 
inside this small box? Or could it be... 
this box itself is the treasure!?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know. No matter what I do, it 
won't open... and I don't know where it 
came from at all. But... I can feel a 
presence, at least."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... you mean it's totally full 
of mysteries!? That makes it even more 
exciting! I'm gonna drown in an ocean of 
romance!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That hand mirror...? Ohhh... Maybe it lets 
you see into the future!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right...! It's not guaranteed, 
but... if the mirror is in a good mood...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So I get to see the castle I'm gonna 
build, huh! Lemme see that for a sec—
(Clatter...!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What!? Did that doll just move!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like it's happy that a customer 
showed up. That one... really loves 
chatting, you see..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?! Then I'm with you all the 
way! Having a chat with a doll isn't 
something you get to do every day!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Let's chat!! Until our voices give out!"

With eyes sparkling at every single item, 
Tap Dance City happily finished tidying 
up.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all tidied up. I had a great time 
seeing the two of you's treasure trove!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A treasury...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"With unique research, dancing dolls... 
and tons of other treasures for the two of 
them!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that perspective isn't wrong. It 
seems my treasures will keep multiplying, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If this place ever gets too cramped, just 
let me know. I'll prepare a massive 
treasure vault for you back at my castle!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
These are the treasures I worked hard to 
gather. I ain't gonna let anyone throw 'em 
away!
choice_data_list: Then we'll have to make it super sturdy!

Looks like it'll become a treasure trove 
full of variety.

Looks like it'll become a treasure trove 
full of variety, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
These are the treasures I worked hard to 
gather. I ain't gonna let anyone throw 'em 
away!
choice_data_list: Then we'll have to make it super sturdy!

Looks like it'll become a treasure trove 
full of variety.

Looks like it'll become a treasure trove 
full of variety, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To display every single treasure 
imaginable! My castle welcomes romance in 
all its forms!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Much obliged. If I can gather 
materials without worrying about storage 
space, my research will make great 
progress.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to it! Make sure you 
show me some mind-blowing results!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Unfurl the sails, and let us chase romance 
together!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Everyone will be displaying their 
own treasures, after all. It's gonna be 
lively!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Everyone can stay close 
friends there... forever.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you gotta come hang out too, 
okay? Everyone's gonna miss you if you 
don't.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Treasure is meant to be admired! Feel free 
to have as much fun in my castle as you 
like!
